visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera moves forward in a first-person perspective through a brightly lit office environment. A hand with tan skin holds a white ceramic mug with a black geometric grid pattern, filled to the brim with a brown liquid. In the background, white office desks with monitors, ergonomic chairs, and office supplies are visible under bright fluorescent lights. (2) The camera approaches a person with short, dark curly hair and thick black-rimmed glasses sitting at a desk in a teal sweatshirt. The person holding the mug offers it, and the colleague looks at it suspiciously while gesturing with their hands. Another man with short black hair and a black shirt enters the background, laughing and watching the interaction. (3) The colleague in the teal sweatshirt takes a large sip from the mug, looking hesitant. The person holding the mug then flips it upside down, revealing a QR code printed on the bottom surface of the mug, covered in a thin layer of brown foam. (4) The video transitions into a montage of interviews in the same office. A man with a black baseball cap and large over-ear headphones speaks enthusiastically. A man in a grey polo shirt speaks into a microphone held near his face. A woman with long hair and a multi-colored necklace smiles and talks to the camera. (5) A man in a white lace-patterned shirt speaks, holding up four fingers and gesturing toward his chest. The camera captures close-up shots of their facial expressions and hand movements. The scene ends with a screen recording of a mobile music app displaying a playlist titled '哈哈台宇宙寶藏大歌單'.

(3) The audio track cuts to a series of short interview clips. Each clip features a different speaker with clear, enunciated vocals and varying pitch levels.
